item.title: About me
item.description: Hi! I’m Joseph Liu, a computer science student from Canada. Starting Fall 2024, I’ll be studying at the University of Waterloo; before that, I graduated from the IB Diploma program in high school with 45/45 points. I love to program in my free time, and have built and contributed to various projects over the years—more on those below. Besides programming, I also enjoy writing, playing tennis, and the very occasional anime/manga; my favorite anime this year was Frieren.
